info.title: My Swim Day public schedule API
info.description: Read-only practice, meet, and team-event times. No API key. Hourly limits scale with team size; excess traffic returns HTTP 429 until the window resets. JSON/spoken for voice assistants; ICS for iPhone Calendar subscriptions.

get.summary: Practice, meet, and team-event times for a day
get.description: Ask for a team's schedule on today, tomorrow, this Friday, next Monday, or a calendar date. Default is practices for one or more groups. Add include=meets, events, or all. Returns structured sessions plus a `spoken` sentence for voice.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Tenant slug or alias, e.g. DelmarDolfins or DelmarDolphins.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: One or more practice groups: Sr, Sr,Jr, senior and junior. Required when include is practices (the default) or all. Optional for include=meets / events. Repeat group= or use groups=.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: today (default), tomorrow, yesterday, this Friday, next Monday, Friday, or YYYY-MM-DD in the team timezone. `this` is the current Sun–Sat week; `next` is the following week; a bare weekday is the upcoming day including today.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: What to return. Default is practices only. Use meets, events, all, or meets,events. Alias: kind=. Group is required for practices, optional for meets/events-only.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default) or spoken (plain text of the spoken field, for Siri Shortcuts).

200.description: Schedule for that team, group, and day.

schema.example: Sr practice for Delmar Dolfins today is 5:30 AM to 7:00 AM at BCHS.

400.description: Missing or unknown group, or invalid date.

429.description: Team or client is over the hourly cap. Retry after the number of seconds in Retry-After.

502.description: Upstream Commit schedule could not be loaded.

get.summary: ICS feed for iPhone Calendar (and one-off Add to Calendar)
get.description: Without `d=`, returns a live text/calendar subscription for team + groups (past 7 days through 8 weeks). Subscribe with webcal:// or paste the https URL in Calendar → Add Subscription Calendar. With `d=`, serves a client-built one-off ICS for Safari Quick Look.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Required for the live feed. Tenant slug or alias, e.g. DelmarDolfins or 1.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Practice groups for the feed. Required unless include is meets/events only.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Default practices only. Use meets, events, all, or meets,events.

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: Weeks ahead to include (1–12, default 8). Past 7 days always included.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Legacy one-off payload: base64url of a UTF-8 ICS document.

application/json.description: Usage index when called with no query.

400.description: Missing or unknown group, or invalid include / encoded payload.

429.description: Team or client is over the hourly cap.

502.description: Upstream Commit schedule could not be loaded.

200.description: Teams available on My Swim Day.

spoken.example: Sr practice for Delmar Dolfins today is 5:30 AM to 7:00 AM at BCHS.
